subject: fixed XXH3_stream performance with DISPATCH
perf_evidence: Subject "fixed XXH3_stream performance with DISPATCH": XXH3_64bits_update_dispatch used to call the generic XXH3_update() with run-time function pointers for accumulate_512/scrambleAcc (no inlining); the commit adds per-ISA XXH3_64bits_update_{scalar,sse2,avx2,avx512} instantiations and dispatches one function pointer per update call.
change_summary: xxh_x86dispatch.c: new per-ISA update functions (XXH3_update with constant accumulate/scramble), new `update` field in the dispatch table struct (g_dispatch / k_dispatch grow 24->32 / 96->128 bytes), XXH3_64bits_update_dispatch calls g_dispatch.update instead of XXH3_update(..., g_coreFunc.accumulate_512, g_coreFunc.scrambleAcc).

units.name: per-ISA streaming update, ISA=AVX2 (old: XXH3_update with k_coreFunc[AVX2] pointers; new: XXH3_64bits_update_avx2)
units.precondition: dispatcher has selected the same ISA on both sides (setDispatch/XXH_featureTest are unchanged by the commit)
units.evidence: Alive2 fwd+bwd correct, --unroll 8 (>= max trip count 4), fixed lengths reset+update(100)+update(200)+digest

units.name: per-ISA streaming update, ISA=SSE2
units.precondition: dispatcher selected SSE2 on both sides

units.name: per-ISA streaming update, ISA=scalar
units.precondition: dispatcher selected scalar on both sides

units.name: dispatcher entry XXH3_64bits_update_dispatch through the global dispatch tables (fixed AVX2 / SSE2 CPU models, symbolic CPU)
units.evidence: alive-tv: "Unsupported interprocedural transformation: global variable @g_dispatch has different size in source and target (24 vs 32 bytes)" (also r_upd64_cpu1, r_noinit_cpu0; @k_dispatch 96 vs 128)

notes: Coverage: the computational part of the change (per-ISA update vs. the old pointer-parametrised XXH3_update for the same ISA) is EQUIV_BOUNDED for scalar/SSE2/AVX2 (AVX512 not checked: target("avx512f") functions cannot be inlined into an x86-64-v3 compile); the dispatch plumbing (function-pointer tables in mutable globals whose layout grows) cannot be compared by Alive2 (global of different size). By source inspection setDispatch assigns k_dispatch[vecID].update = XXH3_64bits_update_<vecID> consistently with k_coreFunc[vecID] = {accumulate_512_<vecID>, scrambleAcc_<vecID>}. Harness wrap_isa.c: the ONLY side-specific code is which function is called (old: XXH3_update(s,p,n,XXH3_acc_64bits,XXH3_accumulate_512_X,XXH3_scrambleAcc_X) = body of old XXH3_64bits_update_dispatch with g_coreFunc=k_coreFunc[X]; new: XXH3_64bits_update_X), selected by XXH_SIDE_NEW from {old,new}_model/xxh_side.h because the per-ISA functions do not exist in the old file. Stack state, memset, XXH3_64bits_reset, update(100), update(200) (crosses the 256-byte buffer), XXH3_64bits_digest. xxh_x86dispatch_model.c = xxh_x86dispatch.c with only the cpuid/xgetbv asm bodies replaced (mk_model.py). Runner c/xxHash/4f43b71/xx_alive_d.py (brief runner + extra normalisations) with --func; result.json "bounded" is module-wide. Control: XXH_featureTest unchanged -> r_feat_cpu0 EQUIV (IR identical, cpuid modelled as uninterpreted pure functions). flags -O3 -march=x86-64-v3 -DXXH_NO_INLINE_HINTS=1 + inline/unroll/memdep -mllvm limits (see result.json cflags).
